items.source: In 2.0.0-M3, spring-ai-anthropic was rewritten on top of the official com.anthropic:anthropic-java SDK, replacing the hand-rolled RestClient / WebClient implementation. The previous AnthropicApi class was a 2,300-line file with 47 nested DTO records.
items.translation: 在2.0.0-M3版本中，spring-ai-anthropic基于官方的com.anthropic:anthropic-java SDK进行了重写，取代了之前手工编写的RestClient/WebClient实现。此前的AnthropicApi类是一个包含2,300行代码和47个嵌套DTO记录的庞大文件。

items.source: The Maven coordinates, the spring-ai-starter-model-anthropic Boot starter, and the spring.ai.anthropic.* configuration properties are all unchanged. The ChatClient API is unchanged. ChatModel.call(Prompt) and ChatModel.stream(Prompt) keep their signatures. AnthropicChatOptions keeps all existing fields, adding new ones for skills, web search, service tier, inference geo, and structured output.
items.translation: Maven 坐标、spring-ai-starter-model-anthropic Boot 启动器以及 spring.ai.anthropic.* 配置属性均未更改。 ChatClient API 保持不变。 ChatModel.call(Prompt) 和 ChatModel.stream(Prompt) 保留了其方法签名。 AnthropicChatOptions 保留了所有现有字段，并新增了用于技能、网络搜索、服务等级、推理地理位置和结构化输出的字段。

items.source: Per-request HTTP headers on AnthropicChatOptions#httpHeaders, distinct from client-level customHeaders on AbstractAnthropicOptions. customHeaders is set once on the client and applies to every request; httpHeaders is set per Prompt and merged in at request-build time. Useful for request tracing, beta-API toggles, and routing.
items.translation: AnthropicChatOptions#httpHeaders 上的每请求 HTTP 头，与客户端级别的 customHeaders（位于 AbstractAnthropicOptions 上）不同。customHeaders 仅在客户端设置一次并应用于所有请求；而 httpHeaders 针对每个 Prompt 设置，并在构建请求时进行合并。此功能适用于请求追踪、Beta API 开关切换以及路由等场景。

items.source: Partial prompt-level options. new Prompt(text, AnthropicChatOptions.builder().maxTokens(2048).build()) no longer inherits model, temperature, etc. from the model’s defaults (see Prompt-level options no longer merge with model defaults). No compile error, no exception; the request runs with different values. If output drifts after the upgrade and you call ChatModel directly, look here first.
items.translation: 部分提示级别选项。 new Prompt(text, AnthropicChatOptions.builder().maxTokens(2048).build()) 不再继承模型的默认值（如 model、temperature 等）（参见提示级别选项不再与模型默认值合并）。不会引发编译错误或异常；请求将以不同的值运行。如果升级后输出出现漂移，并且您直接调用了 ChatModel，请首先查看此处。

items.translation: 提供与供应商无关的请求和响应类型（Prompt、ChatResponse、Generation、Usage），因此应用程序代码不依赖于 com.anthropic.*。

items.source: com.anthropic.core.http.AsyncStreamResponse<RawMessageStreamEvent>. StreamHelper was the internal SSE-merging helper for the old WebClient streaming path; the SDK now delivers stream events natively, and Spring AI bridges them to a Reactor Flux internally. Code calling ChatModel.stream(Prompt) is unaffected.

items.source: AnthropicCacheStrategy.NONE means "unset", not "disabled". Setting NONE at the prompt level falls back to the model default. To turn caching off when the model default has it on, build a second AnthropicChatModel with AnthropicCacheOptions.disabled() as its default.
items.translation: AnthropicCacheStrategy.NONE 表示“未设置”，而非“禁用”。 在提示词级别设置 NONE 将回退到模型默认值。若要关闭缓存（当模型默认开启时），请构建第二个 AnthropicChatModel，并将其默认选项设置为 AnthropicCacheOptions.disabled()。

items.source: Tool cache TTL is taken from MessageType.SYSTEM. resolveToolCacheControl looks up messageTypeTtl(MessageType.SYSTEM) regardless of strategy. Setting messageTypeTtl(MessageType.USER, ONE_HOUR) has no effect on tool caching.
items.translation: 工具缓存的 TTL 取自 MessageType.SYSTEM。 resolveToolCacheControl 会无视策略，直接查找 messageTypeTtl(MessageType.SYSTEM)。因此，设置 messageTypeTtl(MessageType.USER, ONE_HOUR) 对工具缓存没有任何影响。

items.source: AnthropicChatOptions defaults maxTokens to 4096 instead of 500. The previous default routinely truncated responses; the new value matches the other Spring AI chat modules.
items.translation: AnthropicChatOptions 将 maxTokens 的默认值从 500 更改为 4096。 旧默认值经常截断响应；新值与其他 Spring AI 聊天模块保持一致。

items.source: The previous module bundled the text and signature of a thinking block into a single Generation. The SDK delivers them as separate events, and the new module forwards them that way: a Generation with properties.signature arrives after the thinking-text deltas, before any subsequent text deltas. MessageAggregator and `ChatClient’s built-in aggregation absorb the extra chunk transparently.
items.translation: 上一模块将思考块的文本和签名打包为单个 `Generation`。SDK 则以独立事件的形式提供它们，新模块也按此方式转发：在后续文本增量之前，带有 `properties.signature` 的 `Generation` 会在思考文本增量之后到达。MessageAggregator 和 `ChatClient` 内置的聚合机制会透明地吸收这个额外的数据块。

items.source: The 4-breakpoint limit is enforced in Spring AI, not at the API. Anthropic permits at most 4 cache breakpoints per request. The previous module passed markers through and let the API reject excess. CacheBreakpointTracker now keeps count and silently skips additions past 4, logging a one-time WARN. The most likely way to hit the cap is SYSTEM_AND_TOOLS combined with multi-block system caching and citation documents. Requests that previously failed with an API error can now succeed with reduced caching, so check your cache hit rate after the upgrade.
items.translation: The 4-breakpoint limit is enforced in Spring AI, not at the API. Anthropic 允许每个请求最多使用 4 个缓存断点。之前的模块会将标记透传，由 API 拒绝超出部分。CacheBreakpointTracker 现在会进行计数，并在超过 4 个时静默跳过新增项，同时记录一次 WARN 日志。最有可能触达上限的情况是结合使用 SYSTEM_AND_TOOLS、多块系统缓存以及引用文档。此前因 API 错误而失败的请求，现在可以通过减少缓存用量成功执行，因此在升级后请检查您的缓存命中率。

items.source: The Anthropic API requires every DocumentBlockParam with citation configuration in a single request to share the same citations.enabled value. AnthropicChatOptions.validateCitationConsistency() now enforces this and throws IllegalArgumentException before the request is sent. The previous module let the API return an HTTP 400. Tests or call sites that mixed enabled and disabled citation documents will now fail at build time instead of on the network call.
items.translation: Anthropic API 要求单个请求中所有带有引用配置的 DocumentBlockParam 必须共享相同的 citations.enabled 值。 AnthropicChatOptions.validateCitationConsistency() 现已强制执行此规则，并在发送请求之前抛出 IllegalArgumentException。之前的模块允许 API 返回 HTTP 400 错误。 现在，混合启用和禁用引用文档的测试或调用站点将在构建时失败，而不是在网络调用时失败。

items.source: Cache breakpoints dropped past four. Stacking multi-block system caching with tools and citation documents can push past Anthropic’s 4-breakpoint cap. CacheBreakpointTracker skips the extras and logs WARN once. Cache hit rate drops without an error.

items.source: The new module is a thin adapter over the SDK rather than a parallel API. Spring AI’s value is in its own abstractions — ChatModel, ChatClient, advisors, observability, auto-config — and in features that work across providers. Where the SDK already covers a concern (cache-control modeling, streaming, rate-limit handling), the previous module’s wrapper was dropped instead of carried forward, so applications use the SDK’s type directly. This keeps the surface area small and avoids drift as Anthropic ships new SDK releases.
items.translation: 新模块并非与 SDK 并行的 API，而是对 SDK 的轻量级适配器。Spring AI 的价值在于其自身的抽象（如ChatModel、ChatClient、顾问、可观测性和自动配置）以及跨提供商的功能。对于 SDK 已经涵盖的关注点（如缓存控制建模、流式传输和速率限制处理），之前的模块不再提供包装层，而是直接使用 SDK 的类型。这样做保持了 API 表面的简洁性，并避免了随着 Anthropic 发布新的 SDK 版本而产生偏差。

items.source: ToolUseBlock.input() returns the SDK’s JsonValue, not a JSON string. Calling .toString() on a JsonValue produces Java map syntax ({key=value}) that looks like JSON but is not. Walk it with JsonValue.Visitor<T> or serialize via Jackson to get a real JSON string.
items.translation: ToolUseBlock.input() 返回的是 SDK 的 JsonValue，而非 JSON 字符串。对 JsonValue 调用 .toString() 会产生类似 Java Map 语法的输出（{key=value}），其外观像 JSON 但并非真正的 JSON。请使用 JsonValue.Visitor<T> 进行遍历，或通过 Jackson 序列化以获取真实的 JSON 字符串。
